title: Misinterpretation
text: “Haa……”
It seemed like someone was letting out a deep sigh, indeed.
“Rabbit Guy.”
Since I myself had once become a usaunny, I felt like I could understand whatever was troubling Rabbit Guy, so I decided to call out to him.
“What is it?”
Heh heh. Father’s brushing technique was quite excellent. Being on the receiving end of it, one could feel this overwhelming sense of superiority, indeed.
“What’s with that look on your face? I mean, you’re definitely misunderstanding something here. It looks like a victorious smirk, but what exactly are you so proud of!”
“Were you sighing because Father hasn’t brushed you yet?”
“That’s not it! Absolutely not. What on earth did you see in me to reach that conclusion!”
“Do you want Shield Hero to groom your fur?”
Right in the middle of this exchange between Rabbit Guy and myself, Rafumi suddenly appeared and asked.
“You’re not needed here! Go home, I say!”
“Don’t say that. Even I have idle moments sometimes. So why don’t I just listen to pass the time?”
“Listening just to kill time, looking at me with some mysterious sense of superiority—what is wrong with you two! What are you trying to accomplish by teasing me!”
Well, as for what I was trying to accomplish—

Rabbit Guy, who got fairly regular massages from Father, was honestly a bit enviable, I say. His joints moved without much trouble now, and he even studied alongside Father. Honestly, I thought it was about time he grew up and stopped putting Father to so much trouble.
“You look like you want Father to brush you, Rabbit Guy. But you’re already getting regular chiropractic care from Father. Wanting more than that seems downright selfish, I’d say.”
“I told you, that’s not it!”
“Then what is it you want?”
At Rafumi’s question, Rabbit Guy looked away.
“It’s nothing in particular… I’ve already received so much from Iwatani-sama, so there’s nothing more I really want……”

“Hmm… so you can’t just say it honestly, is that it? I am a highly advanced golem from the future, and a spirit besides. Let me guess your troubles from the circumstances—accurately, unlike a certain hero who gets every single choice wrong.”
“Who could that be referring to, I wonder?”

Rafumi said something laced with sarcasm about who-knows-who, indeed. A foolish hero who chose wrong… probably Takt or Itsuki, perhaps? No, in Rafumi’s case, it was probably Ren. He rang a single bell because he kept turning down invitations. There was some strange mission lodged in her head about playing Cupid so he couldn’t escape.
“S-Somebody! These two are trying to do something weird to me! Somebody!”

Rabbit Guy raised his voice, but Keel had already gone out for a walk, and Luna-chan had followed after her. His mysterious cry for help was further drowned out and disappeared amid the cheerful morning chatter of the Filolial-samas coming from outside the tent. Father and the others were probably busy preparing breakfast, so right now it was just me, Rafumi, and Rabbit Guy here.
“Measuring now… hmm, you… you want Shield Hero to pet you all fluffy-like, don’t you?”
“That’s what your calculations came up with!? You really are the clunker that guy keeps talking about, aren’t you!”

“How rude, calling me a clunker! Bow Hero, and now you too—just where exactly am I a clunker! Just what do you take this highly advanced golem and spirit for! You… I’ll make you confess no matter what!”
“That’s the thing that strikes a nerve with you!? Ugh, you’re such a pain!”
“It’s a fact that Rafumi is a clunker, I say.”
Apparently having hit a nerve, Rafumi grabbed Rabbit Guy by the collar.

“Just talk already, or I’ll spread around that speech and the practice lines you’ve been muttering in the middle of the night to everyone. That whole thing you said, ‘Even if the heavens overlook it, justice—’ I’ll recite the entire thing, disguised as you.”
“When on earth were you watching that!? You mean you were hiding and spying on me!? Ngh… I knew that guy was good at hiding, but even you do that too!?”

Ah, of course Rafumi could conceal herself too. Big Sister was just as good as me at hiding and finding others, so it stood to reason that Rafumi, carrying that same trait, could do it too. Still, for someone who claimed to analyze and deduce things, this sure looked like forcing a confession out of him.
“You’d better hurry up and talk, for your own sake.”
“Ngh… fine, I guess I have no choice. But you absolutely must not tell anyone, got it?”
“That depends on your attitude.”

“……Sigh. Fine, I get it. It’s not really any big deal…… it’s just that both Shion and Wolf, who started around the same time as me, can transform back and forth between their demi-human and beastman forms, and I still can’t. I just felt frustrated about that, that’s all.”
Rabbit Guy had a faraway look in his eyes.
“It feels like those two are leagues ahead of me in strength…… I want to catch up to them.”
“Mm-hmm, I see, so basically, you want to become a beastman so Shield Hero can pet you all fluffy.”
“That’s jealousy, I say! You want Father to pet you!”
Getting petted by Father made one feel very happy, indeed.
“Were you two even listening to me!? You clearly weren’t listening at all—you’re just fitting my story into whatever weird conclusion you already had!”

I could turn Father all fluffy myself, indeed. In fact, I was starting to feel like indulging in Father’s enchanting belly. There was something about Father-as-a-peckul that neither the Filolial-samas nor Filo-tan could offer.

“Ugh, that all-knowing look on your face is so infuriating! I never thought it’d be this frustrating, being totally wrong about me and yet unable to shut you up. Forget justice or evil, I just want to punch that face!”
Rabbit Guy shouted angrily.
“I’m telling Iwatani-sama and having him scold you. And I’ll spread some false rumor to Filo-san too. Rafumi-san might not care, but that’ll definitely work on you.”

Ngh, Rabbit Guy really understood well. Never mind Father—what exactly was he planning to whisper into Filo-tan’s ear? If he thought he could just make up lies simply because I couldn’t get close to her, I would not stand for it! Perhaps I should silence him, indeed.
“Now, now, wait. I understand your true feelings now. Either way, the result’s the same.”
“What do you mean the same!? I just want to get stronger!”
“I’m telling you not to hide your true feelings. You want to get stronger, transform into a beastman, and have Shield Hero pet you all fluffy. That’s your real desire, isn’t it?”
“You really forced that conclusion, didn’t you…… Please don’t just mix up my problems with your own conclusions like that.”

Rafumi stopped Rabbit Guy in his tracks as he tried to go tattle to Father. I really did think it was the truth, though. Putting together the facts so far—he felt he was losing to Shion and Wolf, wanted to be doted on in his beastman form, and also wanted to be strong. Once it was framed as beastman-transformation equals strength, even I could understand it.
“I’m gradually getting stronger through treatment too, you know! I’ve been hearing from someone knowledgeable, so eventually I’ll be able to transform too!”
“Hmm… but you say that, and yet you still haven’t managed it, have you? Well then… I am a highly advanced golem from the future. Let me have a look at you, then…… mm-hmm, I see, I see.”
It seemed Rafumi was thoroughly diagnosing Rabbit Guy, with beams shooting from her eyes as she appraised him.

“You share the same characteristics as the Original. At this rate, that treatment of yours is going to take quite a long time, and there’s no telling if you’ll ever reach your goal. Just like how my Original has a low aptitude for beastman transformation.”
“And just what is your Original supposed to be? Chocolate, perhaps?”
“That’s the part of me that’s an event spirit. Not that—I mean the Original as a member of the Raph-species.”
Ah, the Original of the Raph-species referred to Big Sister.
“That’s information from Gaelion, isn’t it? The Original’s beastman transformation.”
